issue.title: [spark dialect] Parser doesn't handle default value for unix_timestamp function

summary.text: A test reproducing the unix_timestamp() parse failure in the Spark dialect failed before the fix and passes after it, with no regressions found, but the mutation check did not reach the required kill rate and the break-my-fix stage was inconclusive. Next, strengthen the tests so they distinguish the fix from mutants, for example by asserting that unix_timestamp() defaults to the current timestamp…
